name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a software or cloud services agreement governing the provider's AI features: how customer input is used, ownership of AI output, restrictions, model training, and AI-specific disclaimers.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI), including breach reporting and subcontractor obligations.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and termination. Executed via a Cover Page and Order Forms.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement giving an early design partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback and participation in the provider's design partner program.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-style Data Processing Agreement defining the provider's obligations as processor or subprocessor of customer personal data, including security, subprocessors, international transfers, and audits.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA under which each party may share confidential information for a stated purpose, with obligations on use, protection, and return of that information.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law and jurisdiction, modifications) and party signature blocks.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, fees, a trademark license, escalation, confidentiality, indemnification, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement letting a prospective customer trial or evaluate a product before committing to a full commercial contract, with limited scope and easy termination.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for professional services delivered under Statements of Work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, intellectual property, warranties, and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service Level Agreement for use with the Cloud Service Agreement, defining target uptime and response times and the service credits owed when they are missed.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing installable (on-premises) software, covering license scope, permitted uses, fees, support, warranties, and liability. Executed via a Cover Page and Order Forms.
